title: This week's hottest mathematics papers on arXiv

sections.title: A 27 x 27 x 27 counterexample to Comon's conjecture
sections.abstract: An explicit rational 27×27×27 symmetric tensor has tensor rank 55 over Q and symmetric tensor rank 56 over C, contradicting Comon's conjecture over several fields.
sections.claimed_result: A small explicit counterexample, using symmetric adjoins, plus a special case of a conjecture from Shitov's 2018 work.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Symmetric tensors with rational entries; comparison of ordinary and symmetric tensor rank over rational, real, and complex fields.
sections.caveat: Preprint construction and consequences require expert verification.

sections.title: Three Problems on Separable Quotients of Precompact Abelian Groups
sections.abstract: Constructs Baire Pontryagin-reflexive groups with strong subgroup properties and no nontrivial separable Hausdorff quotient, answering three cited problems.
sections.claimed_result: ZFC constructions and subgroup/quotient structure theorems resolving Problems 1.25 and 3.12 and realizing three regularity properties.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Precompact abelian groups, Baire and Pontryagin-reflexive groups, separable Hausdorff quotients, and finite powers.
sections.caveat: Specialized constructions and all topological properties need expert checking.

sections.title: Mixed multiplicities and Rees Theorems for graded families and their converses
sections.abstract: Extends Rees's mixed-multiplicity theorem to graded primary families and proves a localized converse under formal equidimensionality.
sections.claimed_result: Joint-reduction formulas, normalized-limit realization, a localized converse, and a Böger-type theorem for graded families.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Noetherian local ring; graded m-primary families; formal equidimensionality for the converse.
sections.caveat: The weak asymptotic converse fails even in a one-dimensional regular local ring.

sections.title: Rayleigh-Residual Flow I: Normal Matrices
sections.abstract: Analyzes the negative gradient flow of squared Rayleigh residual and reduces normal-matrix amplitude dynamics to a low-rank replicator equation.
sections.claimed_result: Positive-residual critical points have descending directions; for normal matrices the critical set, first integrals, escape rates, and trajectory reduction are explicit.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Complex projective space and arbitrary complex matrices for general claims; normal matrices for explicit reduction.
sections.caveat: Practical spectral-exploration benefits are illustrated numerically but lack independent benchmarking in the abstract.

sections.title: Fundamental Lemmas in Universal Resolution
sections.abstract: Abstracts and proves fundamental lemmas for universal blowups and presents corrections and validation of chapters in an earlier preprint.
sections.claimed_result: Proofs of the relevant universal-blowup lemmas and correction/validation of Chapters 5, 6, and 8 of arXiv:2507.21400.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Universal blowups in algebraic geometry, with a number-theory cross-list.
sections.caveat: The abstract gives too little detail to assess the exact corrected hypotheses.

sections.title: The Coproduct of Ideals and the Coprime Spectrum
sections.abstract: Introduces coproducts and coprime ideals, producing a topological coprime spectrum with functorial and classification results.
sections.claimed_result: The coprime spectrum classifies fields among integral domains and recovers the prime spectrum for dual rings.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Arbitrary commutative rings, ideal lattices, suitable ring epimorphisms, integral domains, and dual rings.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not give all proof conditions or limits of the functorial construction.

sections.title: 2-step ideals and commuting matrices
sections.abstract: Uses Hilbert schemes and commuting-matrix varieties to study loci associated with 2-step ideals and derive dimension estimates, especially in three variables.
sections.claimed_result: New proofs of dimension estimates for 2-step ideals in the n=3 case while omitting some earlier assumptions.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: 2-step ideals satisfy m^(k+2) properly contained in I properly contained in m^k; applications concern Hilbert schemes and commuting matrices.
sections.caveat: The abstract omits the numerical bounds, so comparison with prior work requires the full paper.
